name: canvas-prompt
description: A local Excalidraw thinking canvas for Codex that captures voice, spatial context, and process evidence as Prompt Packages.

interface.shortDescription: Capture a thinking process as an auditable Prompt Package.
interface.longDescription: Canvas Prompt opens a local Excalidraw canvas in Codex. It records the human input layer—canvas actions, voice, and time—then exports a Prompt Package that downstream AI can inspect with its evidence intact. It deliberately does not claim in-canvas AI generation or automated teaching as a current capability.
defaultPrompt: Open the Canvas Prompt thinking canvas for this project.
Export this Canvas Prompt session as an auditable Prompt Package.
Read the latest Canvas Prompt Package for this project.
